question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **films**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"films"** refers to motion pictures, movies, or the art of making movies. (फिल्में)

 
 
• **Example: **We watched several films over the weekend.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that one of the finest ways to learn a second language is through audio-video materials like films, which let students interact with cultural information.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct option to fill in the blank is **'films'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **films**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Podcasts** (पॉडकास्ट): Digital audio files made available on the internet for downloading, typically as a series.

 
 
• **Example:** She listens to podcasts while commuting to work.
 
 
 
• **Images** (छवियाँ): Visual representations such as photographs, paintings, or drawings.
 
 
• **Example: **The gallery was filled with beautiful images of nature.
 
 
 
• **Books** (किताबें): Written or printed works consisting of pages glued or sewn together along one side and bound in covers.
 
 
• **Example:** She loves reading mystery books.
